pages.text: A walking chest that follows you and eats items lying on the ground.$(br2)Right-click to open it: it opens its mouth like a chest. Sneak-right-click to pick it up with everything inside.

pages.title: Charged Luggage
pages.text: Struck by lightning, the luggage becomes $(l)charged$(): its skin changes and it holds $(l)54$() stacks instead of 27.$(br2)Keep it within 3 blocks of a $(item)Lightning Rod$() during a thunderstorm and wait for the rod to be struck.
